name: Cardamom-Kiln Caldera
core_rationale: Eleventh spice-glaze ceramic caldera of Hearthbloom Basin where Sola's warm mineral springs steep wild cardamom pods inside tiered porcelain drying kilns.
local_conflict: Aromatic glaze-wisps and terracotta mortar beetles guard the warm cardamom drying domes.

mystery_hook.in_world_rumor: Bathhouse keepers in Ginger-Bathhouse Haven say the eastern Cardamom-Kiln Caldera simmers with spiced porcelain glaze-springs that glow amber beneath the evening mist.
mystery_hook.visual_silhouette: Dome-shaped cardamom drying kilns and terraced porcelain glaze-basins rising beyond the eastern rim of Ginger-Steam Terraces.
mystery_hook.unanswered_question: Which Primordial Kiln-Artisan carved the central spice-glaze crucible of Cardamom-Kiln Caldera?

causal_continuity.evidence: Directly inherits god-sola-hearth-weaver and scar-kiln-basin along the eastern geothermal rim of Continent 01.

fantasy_and_wonder.evidence: Dome-shaped cardamom drying kilns and terraced porcelain glaze-basins simmering in perpetual spring warmth.

character_scale_consistency.evidence: Mystery status: porcelain kiln doorway and drying-terrace metrics for 1.05m characters will be verified upon promotion to Draft.

spatial_and_ecological_consistency.evidence: Mystery status: reserved as the eleventh District frontier on Continent 01 with zero filler maps.

intentional_mystery_discipline.evidence: Provides complete mystery_hook (in_world_rumor, visual_silhouette, unanswered_question) and empty grid_nodes.
